subject: Intro: LumenFlow candidate — Ethan Cole (SWE II) — scheduling + panel availability
messages:
From: Claire Dawson <claire@lumenflowrecruit.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: recruiting@lumenflowrecruit.com
Date: Fri, 24 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Ethan Cole — SWE II — strong backend + Rust experience (resume attached)

Hi Stephanie —

Nice to e-meet you. LumenFlow has a senior/full-stack pipeline engineer, Ethan Cole, who’s interested in the SWE II role on your Backend team. He has ~5 years experience (fintech & infra), solid Rust + Go background, and recent work on low-latency RPC services. I’m attaching his resume and a small one-pager of recent projects.

Quick highlights:
- Built a production Rust service that cut p99 RPC latency by ~30% at a Series B payments company.
- Led migration from monolith to microservices for a high-throughput ingestion pipeline.
- Comfortable with GCP + k8s, feature flagging, and on-call rotations.

He’s available for interviews next week (Mon–Thu afternoons PT) and happy to do an initial 30–45m technical screen + 60m on-site loop. Do you want me to block some windows?

Attachments: resume_ethan_cole.pdf; projects_onepager.pdf

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Dawson | Senior Recruiter, LumenFlow Talent
claire@lumenflowrecruit.com | (415) 555-0123
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 24 Apr 2027 09:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Intro: Ethan Cole — SWE II — strong backend + Rust experience (resume attached)

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding a promising profile from LumenFlow. Can you skim the resume and tell me whether we should do a short 30m screen (Karthik) before scheduling the onsite loop? If yes, Karthik can run the screen next Tue/Thu afternoon and Claire will coordinate candidate availability.

Marissa: topline — Rust + infra experience, came recommended by a trusted agency contact. If you want to proceed, we should try to get a panel that includes you, one backend eng (infra-focused), and a system design engineer.

Karthik: if you’re good, I’ll introduce you to Claire and share candidate windows. I attached the resume Claire sent.

— Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Hiring Lead — Backend Platforms | Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: claire@lumenflowrecruit.com
Date: Fri, 24 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Intro: Ethan Cole — SWE II — strong backend + Rust experience (resume attached)

Thanks Steph — I reviewed the resume. Looks like a solid match for the SWE II spec; we should do a 30m technical screen first to confirm debugging/problem-solving and systems thinking. I can run screens Tue 4/27 2:30–4:30pm PT or Thu 4/29 1:00–3:00pm PT.

Claire — can you check Ethan’s availability for those windows? If he’s good for Tue 2:30pm PT we can slot a 30m screen and then, assuming pass, propose a 60m loop the following week.

Karthik Iyer
Sr. Recruiter | Redwood Inference
From: Claire Dawson <claire@lumenflowrecruit.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, ethan.cole@gmail.com
Date: Mon, 27 Apr 2027 08:10:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Intro: Ethan Cole — availability for Tue 4/27

Hi Karthik —

Ethan can do Tue 4/27 at 2:30pm PT. I’ve confirmed and he’s excited to speak with you. I added the calendar invite (panel_slots_v1.ics) and attached his final resume PDF. Please see candidate note below from Ethan.

Candidate note (copied):
"Happy to chat — I’ve spent the last week finishing a migration at my current company, but Tue afternoon works well. I’d prefer remote for now; happy to do a whiteboard exercise over video"

Next steps:
1) Karthik runs 30m technical screen Tue 4/27 2:30pm PT (video) — please confirm calendar link: https://calendar.redwo.in/meet/2K9jQX
2) If pass, Claire will propose an onsite loop the week of 5/3 including Marissa and two ICs.

Thanks — Claire
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: ethan.cole@gmail.com
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, claire@lumenflowrecruit.com
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 14:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: 30m screen — Tue 4/27 2:30pm PT (confirm)

Ethan — thanks for confirming. I’ll send a short calendar invite for 30 minutes (video). Agenda: quick background, a debugging/short design prompt, and a few Rust-specific questions.

Prep note: have a recent project (system you built) in mind; I may ask about tradeoffs and performance tuning.

Looking forward to meeting you,
Karthik
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, claire@lumenflowrecruit.com
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 14:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Ethan Cole — post-screen feedback + next steps

Quick update after the screen: Karthik — thanks, he did well on the debugging question and answered the Rust tradeoffs confidently. Signal = green for on-site loop. Please ask Claire to propose 60–75m windows next week; priority: Wed 5/5 or Thu 5/6 afternoons PT. I’ll join the loop and would like an infra IC and a systems design IC.

Also — Claire, can you send a quick note to the candidate with an expectations doc (short agenda for the loop) so he knows the format? If we move forward, hiring comp band for SWE II is $150–175k + RSU guidelines; we’ll confirm after loop.

— Marissa
VP, Backend Platforms | Redwood Inference
